translation_snapshot.source: Bluish and wickedly sharp. It makes your arm hair stand on end.
translation_snapshot.target: 这只爪子泛着蓝色光泽并且锋利的吓人，它使你汗毛竖立。

translation_snapshot.source: Unlike the rest of the black mamba, the severed head isn't moving.
translation_snapshot.target: 不像这条蛇的其他部分，这颗头一动不动。

translation_snapshot.source:
As you stand on the stairs you can feel this is a "do or die" one way trip. If you enter there will be no coming back.
Enter?
translation_snapshot.target:
当你站在楼梯上时，你能感觉到这是一次不能回头的战斗，非生既死，一旦进去就不能回来。
现在进去么？

translation_snapshot.source:
The pedestal seems to react to something in your bag. After some tests you notice it is the %s.
Do you wish to use the orb on the pedestal?
translation_snapshot.target:
这个基座似乎对你包里的东西有反应。经过测试后，你发现是包里的%s.
你想在这个基座上使用这个水晶球吗？
